'''Siniteen''' were hyperintelligent humanoids, capable of calculating [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps without the assistance of a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]].

They had pale skin and pupilless eyes. A notable feature of this species were their hairless, oversized heads, which resembled the lobes of a brain.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], one Siniteen, [[Bric/Legends|Bric]], was assigned to train [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] cadets on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]; another, named [[Brainee/Legends|Brainee]], was an associate of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]; and a third, [[Hal'Sted/Legends|Hal'Sted]], was a criminal on the planet of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. [[Pons Limbic/Legends|Pons Limbic]] frequented [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] and was present when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] hired [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to the episode guide for "[[Clone Cadets]]," "Siniteen" is an anagram of "[[Wikipedia:Albert Einstein|Einstein]]."<ref name="Clone Cadets Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/clone-cadets-trivia-gallery|text="Clone Cadets" Trivia Gallery}}</ref>
